title: Doozy Vape Co Infinity Strawberry Watermelon 50/50 Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml
description: Strawberry Watermelon by Doozy Infinity brings together two summer staples in a juicy, sweet-tasting blend. Ripe Strawberry leads the way with its bright, jammy flavour, while Watermelon adds a gentle sweetness and lush, refreshing lift. The combination delivers a fruit vape that’s clean, rounded and irresistibly smooth, making it a great choice for an easy, all-day vape. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this MTL-friendly e-liquid is perfect for pod kits, vape pens and starter devices. The 120ml shortfill bottle includes 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, leaving space to add two 10ml nic shots for a tailored strength. Part of the Doozy Infinity Podfill range, this e-liquid is designed to deliver big flavour and smooth satisfaction in every puff.
